adoption_evidence: Capital-market adoption only, no commercial adoption yet: VOR raised a $75.0M private placement in 2026 and $48.4M via ATM (10-Q 2026-10-30, 0001193125-26-439905); ALLO sold 12,476,533 ATM shares for $20.7M net in 9M 2026 (10-Q 2026-11-06, 0001628280-26-071191); NKTR completed public offerings in Feb and Apr 2026 (424B5s 0001193125-26-049191, 0001193125-26-171717)
No government programme or named commercial customer found in the filings for any member

comparable_prior_wave.name: 2020-21 cell & gene-editing therapy wave (allogeneic/iPSC cell therapy and CRISPR)
comparable_prior_wave.similar: Same platform-promise shape: pre-revenue immune-cell / immune-modulation biotechs funded by equity, re-rated on early clinical data and sector flows (tools.py px 2020-01-01..2021-12-31; troughs 2020-03-16).
comparable_prior_wave.different: ALLO is itself wreckage of that wave (allogeneic CAR-T was a 2020-21 leader theme), so this would be a second wave, driven by the autoimmune indication pivot rather than oncology; leader multiples of 6-19x in that wave fall short of 25x except at the extreme; rates and biotech funding today are not the zero-rate 2020 setting.

themes.wave_score_reason: Phase 3 starts at two issuers and Phase 2 at a third are real maturity steps, but there is no approval, no product revenue and no payer adoption in any filing, and the prior wave in this very theme has already crested and broken.

themes.sub_theme: learning, workforce and B2B-information platforms repriced by generative AI
maturity_signals: Consolidation among incumbents: Coursera completed its combination with Udemy on 2026-05-11 and announced exit/disposal costs (8-K 2.05, filed 2026-11-10, 0001651562-26-000075)

Revenue declines at incumbents attributed in filings to AI search: Chegg sued Google over AI Overviews (CHGG 10-Q filed 2026-05-11, 0001364954-26-000048); TechTarget I&A revenue decline (TTGT 10-Q filed 2026-11-06, 0001193125-26-450764)
Airship AI reports AI video analytics revenue of $23.2M TTM (XBRL, 10-Q filed 2026-11-05, 0001654954-26-009546) with backlog of only $3.3M at 2025-12-31 (10-K filed 2026-02-17, 0001654954-26-001280)
adoption_evidence: TechTarget: 73 customers spent over $1M in 2025, top-50 = ~37% of revenue (10-K filed 2026-03-11, 0001193125-26-102183)
Airship AI: $2.8M commercial refresh award and NSSE-related federal work cited; validated pipeline $173.4M (management figure, not contract) (10-K filed 2026-02-17, 0001654954-26-001280)
Evidence points to AI as a disruptor of these incumbents' revenue, not a wave lifting them; no filing shows revenue mix shifting decisively toward AI products

comparable_prior_wave.name: 2020-21 pandemic edtech wave
comparable_prior_wave.similar: Online-learning/info platforms re-rated together on a demand shock (tools.py px 2019-06-01..2021-03-01: CHGG trough 2020-03-18 to 2021-02-12, 10.9 months; LRN 2020-02-10 to 2020-08-05, 5.8 months).
comparable_prior_wave.different: That wave peaked at ~3-4x for leaders, nowhere near 25x, and CHGG/COUR are its wreckage; today's driver (generative AI) is a substitute for these products, i.e. the opposite sign.

themes.wave_score_reason: Filings show AI eroding these incumbents' revenue and a prior wave that peaked at only 3-4x; no primary evidence of a theme wave that would lift them.
